result.detail: VeriTriage confidence was low (30%, unknown_failure), so the buckets rest on reading the RTL against its header specification. Before signoff I suggest per-log veritriage.investigate runs and same-seed reruns. All three testbenches use the same top module name, tb_pwm_repro, so the top is correct however the platform takes the entry. Each file is meant to be run on its own with the RTL, as stated in the input contract. Every wait is bounded at 64 cycles, and a timeout counts as a failed check, so no run can hang before printing its verdict.
